evals.name: reserve-book
evals.prompt: ReserveBook carries a book ID and a reservation ID. Move the provider call into the proper operation.
assertions: Handle returns an ICommandOperation containing the supplied identifiers.
Injects the reservation provider on Execute and Compensate, not the constructor.
Forwards cancellation and returns no response data from either method.

evals.name: lost-ack
evals.prompt: The reservation provider saved the book but its acknowledgement was lost. How can compensation find the right reservation?
evals.expected_output: Use the same stable reservation identifier.
assertions: Passes the same caller-supplied reservation ID to reserve and cancel.
Does not use a mutable success flag or generate an ID in Handle.
Defines idempotent retry and cancellation behavior and preserves unrelated or confirmed reservations.

evals.name: commit-decision
evals.prompt: When will Arc undo attempted operations?
assertions: Does not undo a committed or unknown outcome.
Compensates attempted operations in reverse order, not in a catch-all block.
